trello.name: Set up Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe to manage three subscription tiers: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise. Ensure these tiers are correctly configured in Stripe and reflected in the app in terms of both functionality and user experience.

trello.name: Develop Frontend Checkout Process
trello.desc: Design and implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements. Ensure the checkout form matches the app’s design and handles errors like invalid card details or insufficient funds gracefully.

trello.name: Design User Dashboard Features
trello.desc: Implement the user dashboard to show current plan details, billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices, and payment history. Ensure it reflects real-time subscription status and notifies users of changes.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API Backend
trello.desc: Set up Stripe’s API to handle all subscription-related tasks, including creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments, and managing webhooks for events like subscription cancellations and payment successes or failures.

trello.name: Create Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Develop handlers for specific Stripe webhook events such as invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Ensure these are tested thoroughly and update the system correctly.

trello.name: Update Frontend for Real-Time Integration
trello.desc: Ensure the frontend components are integrated with the backend API and reflect real-time changes to the subscription status on the dashboard. Handle any integration errors and provide clear user notifications.

trello.name: Prepare Testing Plan
trello.desc: Develop a comprehensive test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow, including edge cases like payment failures and cancellations.

trello.name: Develop User Documentation
trello.desc: Create clear user documentation and support resources, including a help section or FAQ, to guide users in managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and troubleshooting common issues.

trello.name: Document API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to facilitate easier maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: Plan Follow-Up Meeting
trello.desc: Schedule a follow-up meeting to review progress, address any issues, and ensure alignment among team members. Set this meeting for next week.
